The UAV companion model contains no BatchNorm, ReLU, or MatMul+Add patterns, so fusion passes are inapplicable. Shape inference guarantees static shapes for downstream optimizers, while identity and dropout elimination remove trivial nodes. Constant folding is unlikely to reduce nodes here but is harmless. Enabling basic ORT graph optimizations with 4 intra‑op threads and parallel execution should improve runtime without altering the DAG structure.

Dynamic INT8 quantization reduces model size and inference latency on the aarch64 CPU with asimd and asimddp support. Enabling extended ORT graph optimizations can further prune nodes and improve execution speed. Parallel execution with 4 intra‑op threads exploits the 6‑core CPU to lower latency while keeping memory usage modest.
